verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.
verses.pt: Fala a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Sereis santos, porque eu, o Senhor vosso Deus, sou santo.
verses.en_web: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, Yahweh your God, am holy.
verses.en_bbe: Say to all the people of Israel, You are to be holy, for I, the Lord your God, am holy.

verses.en: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: Temerá cada um a sua mãe e a seu pai; e guardareis os meus sábados. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.
verses.en_bbe: Let every man give honour to his mother and to his father and keep my Sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.

verses.en: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: Não vos volteis para os ídolos, nem façais para vós deuses de fundição. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh your God.
verses.en_bbe: Do not go after false gods, and do not make metal images of gods for yourselves: I am the Lord your God.

verses.en: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
verses.pt: Quando oferecerdes ao Senhor sacrifício de oferta pacífica, oferecê-lo-eis de modo a serdes aceitos.
verses.en_web: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.
verses.en_bbe: And when you give a peace offering to the Lord, do it in the way which is pleasing to the Lord.

verses.en: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.pt: No mesmo dia, pois, em que o oferecerdes, e no dia seguinte, se comerá; mas o que sobejar até o terceiro dia será queimado no fogo.
verses.en_web: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day: and if anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.
verses.en_bbe: Let it be used for food on the same day on which it is offered, or on the day after; and whatever is over on the third day is to be burned with fire.

verses.en: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
verses.pt: E se, na verdade, alguma coisa dele for comida ao terceiro dia, é coisa abominável; não será aceito.
verses.en_web: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;
verses.en_bbe: If any of it is used for food on the third day, it is a disgusting thing and will not be pleasing to the Lord.

verses.en: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.pt: E qualquer que o comer levará sobre si a sua iniqüidade, porquanto profanou a coisa santa do Senhor; por isso tal alma será extirpada do seu povo.
verses.en_web: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of Yahweh, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.en_bbe: And as for anyone who takes it for food, his sin will be on him, for he has put shame on the holy thing of the Lord: he will be cut off from his people.

verses.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
verses.pt: Quando fizeres a colheita da tua terra, não segarás totalmente os cantos do teu campo, nem colherás as espigas caídas da tua sega.
verses.en_web: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
verses.en_bbe: And when you get in the grain from your land, do not let all the grain be cut from the edges of the field, or take up what has been dropped on the earth after the getting in of the grain.

verses.en: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: Semelhantemente não rabiscarás a tua vinha, nem colherás os bagos caídos da tua vinha; deixá-los-ás para o pobre e para o estrangeiro. Eu sou o senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.
verses.en_bbe: And do not take all the grapes from your vine-garden, or the fruit dropped on the earth; let the poor man, and the man from another country, have these: I am the Lord your God.

verses.en: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
verses.pt: Não furtareis; não enganareis, nem mentireis uns aos outros;
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.
verses.en_bbe: Do not take anyone's property or be false in act or word to another.

verses.en: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: não jurareis falso pelo meu nome, assim profanando o nome do vosso Deus. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And do not take an oath in my name falsely, putting shame on the name of your God: I am the Lord.

verses.en: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
verses.pt: Não oprimirás o teu próximo, nem o roubarás; a paga do jornaleiro não ficará contigo até pela manhã.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be cruel to your neighbour or take what is his; do not keep back a servant's payment from him all night till the morning.

verses.en: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Não amaldiçoarás ao surdo, nem porás tropeço diante do cego; mas temerás a teu Deus. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Do not put a curse on those who have no hearing, or put a cause of falling in the way of the blind, but keep the fear of your God before you: I am the Lord.

verses.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
verses.pt: Não farás injustiça no juízo; não farás acepção da pessoa do pobre, nem honrarás o poderoso; mas com justiça julgarás o teu próximo.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: Do no wrong in your judging: do not give thought to the position of the poor, or honour to the position of the great; but be a judge to your neighbour in righteousness.

verses.en: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Não andarás como mexeriqueiro entre o teu povo; nem conspirarás contra o sangue do teu próximo. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not go up and down as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Do not go about saying untrue things among your people, or take away the life of your neighbour by false witness: I am the Lord.

verses.en: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
verses.pt: Não odiarás a teu irmão no teu coração; não deixarás de repreender o teu próximo, e não levarás sobre ti pecado por causa dele.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.
verses.en_bbe: Let there be no hate in your heart for your brother; but you may make a protest to your neighbour, so that he may be stopped from doing evil.

verses.en: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Não te vingarás nem guardarás ira contra os filhos do teu povo; mas amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Do not make attempts to get equal with one who has done you wrong, or keep hard feelings against the children of your people, but have love for your neighbour as for yourself: I am the Lord.

verses.en: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
verses.pt: Guardareis os meus estatutos. Não permitirás que se cruze o teu gado com o de espécie diversa; não semearás o teu campo com semente diversa; nem vestirás roupa tecida de materiais diversos.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.
verses.en_bbe: Keep my laws. Do not let your cattle have offspring by those of a different sort; do not put mixed seed into your field; do not put on a robe made of two sorts of cloth.

verses.en: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.pt: E, quando um homem se deitar com uma mulher que for escrava, desposada com um homem, e que não for resgatada, nem se lhe houver dado liberdade, então ambos serão açoitados; não morrerão, pois ela não era livre.
verses.en_web: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed, or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.en_bbe: If any man has sex relations with a servant-woman who has given her word to be married to a man, and has not been made free for a price or in any other way, the thing will be looked into; but they will not be put to death because she was not a free woman.

verses.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.pt: E como a sua oferta pela culpa, trará o homem ao Senhor, à porta da tenda da revelação, um carneiro para expiação de culpa;
verses.en_web: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.en_bbe: Let him take his offering for wrongdoing to the Lord, to the door of the Tent of meeting; let him give a male sheep as an offering for wrongdoing.

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
verses.pt: e, com o carneiro da oferta pela culpa, o sacerdote fará expiação por ele perante o Senhor, pelo pecado que cometeu; e este lhe será perdoado.
verses.en_web: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before Yahweh for his sin which he has committed: and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest will take away his sin before the Lord with the sheep which is offered for his wrongdoing, and he will have forgiveness for the sin which he has done.

verses.en: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
verses.pt: Quando tiverdes entrado na terra e tiverdes plantado toda qualidade de árvores para delas comerdes, tereis o seu fruto como incircunciso; por três anos ele vos será como incircunciso; dele não se comerá.
verses.en_web: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. Three years they shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.
verses.en_bbe: And when you have come into the land, and have put in all sorts of fruit-trees, their fruit will be as if they had not had circumcision, and for three years their fruit may not be used for food.

verses.en: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal.
verses.pt: No quarto ano, porém, todo o seu o fruto será santo, para oferta de louvor ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And in the fourth year all the fruit will be holy as a praise-offering to the Lord.

verses.en: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: E partindo do quinto ano comereis o seu fruto; para que elas vos aumentem a sua produção. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am Yahweh your God.
verses.en_bbe: But in the fifth year you may take the fruit and the increase of it for your food: I am the Lord your God.

verses.en: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
verses.pt: Não comereis coisa alguma com o sangue; não usareís de encantamentos, nem de agouros.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.
verses.en_bbe: Nothing may be used for food with its blood in it; you may not make use of strange arts, or go in search of signs and wonders.

verses.en: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
verses.pt: Não cortareis o cabelo, arredondando os cantos da vossa cabeça, nem desfigurareis os cantos da vossa barba.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.
verses.en_bbe: The ends of the hair round your face and on your chin may not be cut off.

verses.en: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Não fareis lacerações na vossa carne pelos mortos; nem no vosso corpo imprimireis qualquer marca. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: You may not make cuts in your flesh in respect for the dead, or have marks printed on your bodies: I am the Lord.

verses.en: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.pt: Não profanarás a tua filha, fazendo-a prostituir-se; para que a terra não se prostitua e não se encha de maldade.
verses.en_web: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.en_bbe: Do not make your daughter common by letting her become a loose woman, for fear that the land may become full of shame.

verses.en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Guardareis os meus sábados, e o meu santuário reverenciareis. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Keep my Sabbaths and have respect for my holy place: I am the Lord.

verses.en: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: Não vos voltareis para os que consultam os mortos nem para os feiticeiros; não os busqueis para não ficardes contaminados por eles. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am Yahweh your God.
verses.en_bbe: Do not go after those who make use of spirits, or wonder-workers; do not go in their ways or become unclean through them: I am the Lord your God.

verses.en: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Diante das cãs te levantarás, e honrarás a face do ancião, e temerás o teu Deus. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head, and honor the face of an old man, and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Get up from your seats before the white-haired, and give honour to the old, and let the fear of your God be before you: I am the Lord.

verses.en: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
verses.pt: Quando um estrangeiro peregrinar convosco na vossa terra, não o maltratareis.
verses.en_web: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.
verses.en_bbe: And if a man from another country is living in your land with you, do not make life hard for him;

verses.en: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: Como um natural entre vós será o estrangeiro que peregrinar convosco; amá-lo-eis como a vós mesmos; pois estrangeiros fostes na terra do Egito. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.
verses.en_bbe: Let him be to you as one of your countrymen and have love for him as for yourself; for you were living in a strange land, in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

verses.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
verses.pt: Não cometereis injustiça no juízo, nem na vara, nem no peso, nem na medida.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
verses.en_bbe: Do not make false decisions in questions of yard-sticks and weights and measures.

verses.en: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Balanças justas, pesos justos, efa justa, e justo him tereis. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: Have true scales, true weights and measures for all things: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt;

verses.en: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Pelo que guardareis todos os meus estatutos e todos os meus preceitos, e os cumprireis. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall observe all my statutes, and all my ordinances, and do them. I am Yahweh.’”
verses.en_bbe: You are to keep all my rules and my decisions and do them: I am the Lord.
